title: Prove the sharp all-rank floor for immutable mode delivery
body:
The rank-8/rank-9 mixtures left open by PR5808 also fail to save the removed eight H8 calls. This package proves a sharp **8H8 floor for every available rank mixture, any finite number of immutable channels, and every concave power tariff** `Hr=r^q H1`, `0<q<=1`. It permits arbitrary rational payloads, unlimited chronological scatter and joint noise cancellation. More than eight positive-rank channels cost strictly more than `8H8+H1/5`.

The new exact dual has 48 coordinate-basis cuts, 22 response-span cuts and one channel-count row. With rank eight excluded and at least nine channels, its value is `1441100759/20000000 > 72`, so the integer rank mass is at least 73. The full rank-nine response space permits a replacement argument that closes every rank-eight mixture. An exact polynomial comparison proves the full power interval. Eight explicit clean directions attain the quotient floor.

Verification: authenticated PR5808 census and source archive; all 22,585 events and 8,298 chart/response pairs; every rational cut capacity; 48 separate integer determinants; eight attaining witnesses; seven semantic rejection controls; joint-noise and channel-count boundary controls; registered Python 3.12 replay; committed bytes/modes; source-corruption and read-only Git-free optimized replay. Discovery LP/modular outputs are not trusted by the standard-library checker. Full-history preflight was not run in the shallow checkout. Hosted scientific replay and independent human acceptance remain pending.

This closes the fixed word, fixed chart, immutable payload contract. Moving charts, changed feedback or native words remain open. The common-fixed-vector native specialization is retained; no native, owned-erasure, compiler, precision/tape or analytic assumption is discharged. PR5745 retains the separate physical eight-H8 construction and its extra ordinary costs. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19205718). Source PR5808: `f7c198d38d5f68b0753dd0a51a2328e145b07638`. Credit PR5755/flyingviper, PR5745, PR5720, Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis, Dugongue and all retained source authors. New proof and certificate by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. The response census is reused unchanged and is not claimed as a new independent implementation.

CI dependency: this PR also includes the unchanged test-only repair from PR5761, commit `ba8a9e640e1983f3c29993fefa3f46e8ed03313a`, cherry-picked with original authorship and provenance. It separates the frozen revision-7 routing fixtures from the live priority-8 catalogue. It changes no research artifact or mathematical claim. The 12 focused assignment tests pass locally; hosted status remains separate.


Clean-checkout source repair: the initial hosted job could not resolve pending predecessor commits. SOURCES.json now binds the exact retained input copies in this PR history; retained_predecessors preserves every original head, path, blob and SHA256 plus the retained file/archive member. Original and retained bytes were checked equal. Metadata, committed bytes/modes and declared-pin ancestry checks pass. Source bytes, mathematical assertions and scientific receipts are unchanged. The full-history preflight remains unrun in this shallow checkout. Hosted replay is queued for the new head.
